mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS not declining in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1% triggers expectations of monetary easing, reducing risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns despite FEDFUNDS < 1% in the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and fall in labor unemployment (UNRATE) strengthens economic momentum, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls but 20d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, sustained increases in the federal funds rate raise borrowing costs, dampening equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: In a monetary tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS rises but 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained inflationary pressure indicated by CPIAUCSL exceeding 237 triggers market concerns about higher interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL crosses above 237 but 20d returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals robust economic activity, boosting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise in the same period but 60d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (PAYEMS <5,000) and low labor participation (UNRATE <6.5%) create a strong labor market, fostering confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS <5000 and UNRATE <6.5% but 5d returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in demand for loans (RSAFS <400,000) during a post-shock recovery signals improved business conditions, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS <400000 in post-shock recovery regime but 20d returns are negative.
